title: Ankhorage Graph Cytoscape
summary: Converts canonical Ankhorage graph data into Cytoscape element definitions.
purpose: Provide a narrow Cytoscape adapter so graph consumers can render canonical graph models without making the core graph package depend on Cytoscape.
responsibilities: Translate canonical graph data into Cytoscape element definitions.
Expose the Cytoscape adapter through the published package boundary.
boundaries: Does not own graph algorithms or dependency semantics.
Does not own Cytoscape lifecycle, layouts, styling, or UI behavior.
audience: Applications that render @ankhorage/graph models with Cytoscape.
useCases: Convert canonical graph nodes and edges into Cytoscape elements.

architecture.role: Thin adapter from the canonical graph model to Cytoscape element definitions.
invariants: The adapter depends on the published canonical graph package.
Graph analysis remains outside the Cytoscape adapter.

limitations: Consumers own Cytoscape lifecycle, layout, and styling.
